scope: Derived execution receipts only. Original execution bytes are retained locally; their hashes are provenance anchors, not proof of byte equality with these public copies. All six gzip numeric receipts retain their original bytes.
serialization: Parse original UTF-8 JSON with optional BOM; replace only listed JSON pointers; append public_derivation; serialize UTF-8 without BOM, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, LF and one final newline.
projection: Remove public_derivation; replace each listed pointer value with the literal <PATH-REDACTED>; hash canonical JSON: sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False, UTF-8.

placeholders.${REPO_ROOT}: Checkout directory used by the recorded process.
placeholders.${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE}: Interpreter used by the recorded process; choose an installed compatible Python for reproduction.
placeholders.${PATHSEP}: Recorded path-list separator; use os.pathsep on the reproduction platform.
placeholders.${EXTRA_DEPENDENCIES}: Recorded additional dependency directory outside the checkout; install the documented dependencies for reproduction instead of assuming this directory exists.

run_final_refinement.ps1.reason: Historical machine-specific wrapper. Its SHA remains in the successful execution receipt. Replaced for reproduction only by run_final_refinement.py; no new simulation is claimed.

curate_maintained_final.py.reason: Historical curation helper depended on private run directories and would restore unredacted receipts. The portable inspector is the public verification entry point.

remaining_recorded_paths_scope: These four values remain in the lossless archived inputs for exact input-hash verification. They are inert run-location metadata, not portable reproduction settings. No claim that the entire archive is path-redacted is made.
